[[Bill Rogers]] ([[JN076]]-present) }} '''Goh's Boldore''' (Japanese: '''ゴウのガントル''' ''Goh's Gantle'') is the sixth {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that [[Goh]] {{pkmn2|caught}} in the [[Galar]] [[region]], and his seventy-first overall. ==History== ==={{aniseries|JN}}=== [[File:Goh and Boldore.png|thumb|left|250px|Boldore and Goh]] In ''[[JN050|A Pinch of This, a Pinch of That!]]'', [[Goh]] first encountered {{p|Boldore}} when it confronted [[Chloe's Eevee]] in the [[Wild Area]]. He caught it after a brief battle with {{TP|Goh|Cinderace}} and later used it to battle a rampaging {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Arctozolt}}. The battle was eventually interrupted by the arrival of {{Ash}} and his {{AP|Dracovish}}. In ''[[JN076|All Out, All of the Time!]]'', Goh used Boldore to ride on during the [[Pokémon Catch Adventure Race]]. During the course, Goh uses Boldore to save the [[All-Out Brothers]] from a huge boulder that was heading their way after an attempt to execute a [[Z-Move]]. In ''[[JN102|Battling in the Freezing Raid!]]'', Boldore was the last Pokémon used by Goh in a [[Raid Battle (GO)#In animation|Raid Battle]] against an {{p|Articuno}}. During the battle, it tried to protect [[Ash's Pikachu]] and [[Horace]]'s {{p|Bayleef}} from a {{m|Sheer Cold}} attack. The attack was too powerful, however, and everyone but Bayleef ended up being defeated. In ''[[JN107|Big Brother to the Rescue!]]'', Goh used Boldore, along with other Pokémon in the park, to create a fountain so that {{TP|Goh|Grimer}} and {{TP|Goh|Froakie}} could live in [[Cerise Laboratory]] without dirtying the stream. In ''[[JN135|Heroes Unite!]]'', Boldore joined the rest of Goh's Pokémon at the lab to celebrate their Trainer's return from the last mission of [[Project Mew]]. In ''[[JN136|This Could be the Start of Something Big!]]'', it attended a surprise party hosted by the Lab members commemorating Goh and Ash's departure. ==Personality and characteristics== [[File:Goh Boldore Roggenrola.png|thumb|right|250px|Boldore and Roggenrola]] Boldore is a very tough Pokémon, capable of withstanding {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Arctozolt}}'s direct attacks, as mentioned by [[Goh]]. This strength is seen again when Boldore is able to hurl a huge boulder away during the [[Pokémon Catch Adventure Race]]. In the [[Cerise Laboratory]], Boldore is often seen with other {{type|Rock}} Pokémon, most notably with Goh's {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Roggenrola}}. {{-}} ==Moves used== {{anmov/h|rock|rock|Goh Boldore {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Harden|1=Stone Edge|2=Headbutt}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Harden|1=Stone Edge|2=Headbutt}}}} {{anmov|rock|Stone Edge|JN050|A Pinch of This, a Pinch of That!}} {{anmov|normal|Harden|JN050|A Pinch of This, a Pinch of That!}} {{anmov|normal|Headbutt|JN076|All Out, All of the Time!}} {{anmov/f|rock}} ==Related articles== {{Animespecies|Boldore}} {{Goh's Pokémon|rock}} {{Project Anime notice|no}} [[Category:Goh's Pokémon|Boldore]] [[es:Boldore de Goh]] [[it:Boldore di Goh]]
